title: The files of the export read back as the board
how: The board has 5 layers: the two copper layers, the mask, the paste and the outline each give one file = 5 files; the plated drill file (pads 1 of both components and the 2 vias = 4 holes)
and the unplated drill file (the mounting hole of each component = 2 holes) make 7 files in all;
each file is read back with the import and compared with the board with the tolerance of the import: no difference, no file that fails.
